nameOfQualification: Production Technician: In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) Kits (Class A and Class B)
description: The Production Technician for In-Vitro Diagnostic Kits (Class A and Class B) manufacturing is responsible for operating the machines following Good Manufacturing Practices for the manufacturing of In-Vitro Diagnostic Kits (Class A and Class B). The jobholder verifies the output to ensure that in batch manufacturing, the quality parameters are met and performs basic in-process quality checks to ensure total quality management. He/she do routine analysis of manufacturing procedure. He/She also generates the critical records for every activity performed in compliance with data integrity rules. He/she also analyzes and reports production issues to seniors to solve work related problems. He/she also inspects products to verify conformance to specification.
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling
